facts.content: The default embedding model is Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5. It makes 384-dimension vectors and runs in the process, on the CPU. A wiki names another model with the embeddingModel key of wikifact.json.
When the update agent fails on a request, the worker puts the request back in the queue. After 3 attempts the request ends in the failed state and is not tried again.
The standard preset runs Q1 on claude-sonnet-5-5 with low effort and Q4 on claude-sonnet-5-5 with high effort. The other questions run on claude-haiku-5-5.
The replay test fails when the pipeline writes a duplicate fact or a compound fact. Any other miss is reported and does not fail the run.
The worker holds a lock file with its pid. When the process of that pid is gone, the lock is stale: the next worker removes it and takes it over. A live pid blocks a second worker.
A process started with a log directory writes 2 JSON-lines files there, one for all events and one for errors, rotated by size. Without a log directory it writes to stderr.
The WikiFact search result cap (searchCap) is 10 results per search call.
Consumer search drops results below the relevance floor, while agent search with includeHistory applies no floor and keeps near misses.
Consumer search keeps a result lacking a near vector when its full-text row matches two or more distinct query terms, or matches the sole term of a one-term query.
Fact confidence is 1 - 2^(-s), where s sums update and retrieval weights, each decayed by a 30-day half-life from the newest observed version.
The usefulness half-life in search ranking is 30 days.
The MCP server checks that a search query is at most 512 tokens long.
Search queries are embedded without an instruction prefix before vector retrieval.
The WikiFact update worker polls the request queue every 1000 milliseconds.
The budget quality preset runs claude-haiku-5-5 at low effort on every question.
The WikiFact update worker's question Q1 matches only claims that concern a single scope.
In the WikiFact update pipeline, question Q4 classifies each submission into an outcome.
The KNN search over current_vec takes 100 candidates (VEC_CANDIDATES) from the 1-bit vectors.
The relevance eval passes when every answerable query has its fact in the top 3, 90 percent of terms-form queries rank it first, and unanswerable queries return nothing.
The update worker processes one request at a time, guarded by an exclusive lock file beside the database.
The history search collapses its results to one entry per fact.
The operator console refuses to queue deletion of a tag that has live facts, so the operator must merge that tag into another tag first.
The eval question runner passes a configuration when pooled runs have a mean of at least 0.9 and no run below 0.85.
The agent-facing getTag tool takes a limit argument that caps the number of facts returned.
